subject: NIMBLE-related ecological statistics post-doc: application deadline extended

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: NIMBLE-related ecological statistics post-doc: application deadline extended
parts:
Dear nimble-users,

Here is a post-doc position for statistical modeling of large carnivore populations in Scandinavia using nimble: https://tinyurl.com/y5l86e3g

The position is based near Oslo and will involve collaboration with the nimble team in Berkeley, California, USA as well as great people in Montpellier, France and Maryland, USA.

The primary emphasis for this position is experience with Bayesian statistical modeling.  This is more important than experience with ecology or spatial capture-recapture models.  Therefore this position provides an ideal opportunity for a Ph.D. in Statistics to gain experience working on ecological statistical problems.

Please help us spread the word.

-Perry
